info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Careers Applications Interviews-v1-spec
info.description: The Interview Applications Retrieval API allows businesses to efficiently access and manage interview applications tied to career opportunities. Through this endpoint, consumers can retrieve detailed information about candidate interviews, facilitating better decision-making in the hiring process. This API is particularly useful for HR professionals and recruitment teams looking to assess application statuses, interview feedback, and overall candidate engagement. By streamlining access to this data, organizations can enhance their recruitment workflows and improve candidate experience.

get.summary: Retrieve interview details for an application.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the interview details associated with a specific application. Use this to get information such as scheduled times, interviewers, and locations for interviews linked to your application.
